doc.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021

title: First paying gig and the Metronome All-Stars
summary: First paid gigs were rhythm and blues and top 40s with a group called The Metronome All-Stars.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Can you recall the first gig you ever played where you made some money?
Yeah, I guess. We were just doing regular things, you know, what was that, just regular rhythm & blues
You know we was doing all that kind of stuff. So you know we had a group, I guess it was called The Metronome All-Stars. So we’d be doing top 40s —
It’s funny you mention that, that’s the picture of Charlie Parker over my shoulder, the Metronome All-Stars.
